children: and named John Collins as the new CFO of the combined company. LivePerson stock stops trading on Nasdaq. Shares of SoundHound were down 0.52% intraday. The company disclosed no purchase price.

Collins held the CFO, COO and interim CEO roles at LivePerson. He led a shift from more than $100 million of annual cash burn to positive free cash flow inside a year, alongside cost reduction programs exceeding $200 million and debt restructurings that captured $227 million of discount.

SoundHound retired LivePerson's outstanding debt at close, leaving the balance sheet debt-free. Holders of LivePerson's first and second lien secured notes released the debt in exchange for 36,894,839 shares of SoundHound Class A stock, registered for resale the same day. That's worth roughly $249 million at the current price of $6.74.

Management is targeting more than $500 million in future revenue from the existing customer base alone, while Gartner forecasts that enterprise spending on agentic AI software will reach $985 billion by 2030.

title: SoundHound Closes LivePerson Deal And Issues 37 Million Shares
